leftEvidence.title: Isaac names fire and wood and asks where the lamb is

points.label: Speech
points.left: Isaac asks and Abraham is addressed as father.
points.right: Abraham answers, and no further speech from Isaac is recorded.

points.label: Objects
points.left: Wood, fire, and knife are carried.
points.right: Wood, altar, binding, and knife shape the action.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving sequence, speaker, genre, later interpretation, and each source’s stated limits.

rightEvidence.title: Abraham speaks of provision, then builds, binds, lays, and reaches
